name: RhythMix Entertainment

reviews.text: Our DJ, host, musicians and support team were world class! Our wedding happened during a once-in-a-decade snowstorm and they made sure the event went off without a hitch. Not only did they ensure our day flowed smoothly, they made sure EVERYBODY stayed on the dance floor all night (including a few of our caterers, haha). Couldn’t have asked for a better music crew!
reviews.author: Taurean Small

reviews.text: Jeff and his team at Rhythmix are the vibe makers, the music mixers, and the most amazing DJs and entertainment group of all time. I cannot express how amazing but will say that even looking at the pictures make the moments come back to life in our minds. Their work was nothing short of incredible work throughout the entire planning process, the attention to detail on the big day, and their quick thinking, made to every aspect of our day to be exactly as we wanted it. They beautifully accompanied our first dance and set the tone in the room before we even walked in the door, people told me they didn’t leave the dance floor all night and every time they tried they were pulled back in by another great song. Huge shout out to our violinist, he was there for every moment adding so much fun into every song, and to our drummer who made the live music aspect come to life while listening to our favorite songs! They cheered us on as we performed an impromptu musical number and led our family traditions with such great enthusiasm, even those who did not know what they were joined in and felt welcome. They made sure there was no down time, had everything ready to go from the ceremony, cocktail hour, and last moments of the night and worked with my very picky music taste. They even curated an entire playlist of rap songs done in classical music style for the waiting music prior to the ceremony and my husband could not have been happier. The team that Jeff brought with him, Lawrence and David were phenomenal, and we could not have imagined a different group of people, set up, or experience for our special day, it will be one to remember for the rest of our lives and we will be forever grateful!
reviews.author: Sandra Levine

reviews.text: WOW WOW WOW. I quite literally have never been on a more hype dance floor – Brandon made our dance floor ELECTRIC. I heard so many good things about his work prior to booking and he exceeded my very high expectations. Matthew our saxophonist was on the dance floor all night and was such a hit. I had so many of my guests tell me that that was the best DJ they’ve ever heard and I had some engaged friends reach out to Matthew for their future wedding. We also had a live violinist for our ceremony (romantic vibe) and cocktail hour (pop music / Bridgerton vibe) – it was a hit and she hit the nail on the head. We were so happy with this squad!!!
reviews.author: Lexi Lipsman

reviews.text: We couldn’t have asked for a better person to DJ our wedding.  From the ceremony, through the cocktail hour and then all the way to the last song, the music flowed perfectly.  Brandon and his team kept the dance floor full, the transitions between dances and speeches and song were seamless, and the vibes were immaculate.  Professional, friendly, and truly attentive to every degree and we would highly recommend Brandon, Paulie and John for any wedding!
reviews.author: Kevin Patterson

reviews.text:
We had the pleasure of having Rob B as our DJ for our June 29th wedding, and he was absolutely AMAZING. Leading up to the big day, he met with us multiple times to go over our music selections and the overall atmosphere we wanted for our celebration. He truly took the time to get to know our tastes, and he made sure our “must-have” songs played during the peak dance floor moments.

On the wedding day, Rob handled our ceremony and cocktail hour music flawlessly. He was also an incredible MC, keeping everything on track from introductions to speeches to our special dances. Once the dancing began, he knew exactly how to keep the energy high and the dance floor packed, which made the night unforgettable for us and our guests. I had multiple guests tell me that Rob was one of the best DJs they have seen at a wedding.

We cannot recommend Rob and RhythmMix enough. He helped make our wedding absolutely perfect!
reviews.author: Catherine Rowe
